title: Storybound place music
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/music/<path>.json — a place's music: a track played while its conditions hold for the player (a structure, a biome, a dimension; a quest's state, a flag), when no dialogue and no stage of the tracked quest has music of its own. Vanilla's music keeps quiet while it plays; tracks fade into each other.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases.

track.description: The track: an .ogg of the story's sounds/ folder (sounds/<namespace>/<name>.ogg is <namespace>:<name>; a long one is streamed) or any sound the game knows.

conditions.description: When it plays (where the player is, the story's state); always without them.

priority.description: Of several whose conditions hold, the highest plays; equal ones: the first by id.
